title: PublicServices
description: A public service is a set of mandatory or optionally performed or implementable actions by or in the name of a public organisation. The service is for the benefit of an individual, a company, another public organization or groups.

type.description: The type of Public Service. For example: Orientation, Guidance, etc. Lijst van PubliekeDienstverleningtype items.

uses.description: References to all Inputs used by the Public Service to produce one or more Outputs. Lijst van WorkPreferences items.

hasParticipation.description: The Agents who participate in the Public Service. Lijst van Participation items.

produces.description: The references to all the resources produced by the Public Services. Lijst van ActivationProcess items.
